node.statement: Validation-gated lower-bootstrap derivation. This step requires nodes 1.3.2.1 and 1.3.2.2 to be validated and supplies no unconditional conclusion before then. Once they are validated, fix n and define a_n=inf_{X nonzero} ||gamma_n(X)||/||X||. Node 1.3.2.1 supplies c_0<=a_n<=5 and ||gamma_n(X^dagger X)-gamma_n(X)^dagger gamma_n(X)||<=D e||X||^2. For nonzero X, the definition of a_n and the exact source C*-identity give a_n||X||^2=a_n||X^dagger X||<=||gamma_n(X^dagger X)||. The triangle inequality and the target upper C*-inequality then give ||gamma_n(X^dagger X)||<=(1+epsilon)||gamma_n(X)||^2+D e||X||^2. Divide by ||X||^2 and take the infimum to obtain a_n<=(1+epsilon)a_n^2+D e, equivalently a_n(1-a_n)<=epsilon a_n^2+D e. If a_n>=1, a_n>=1-K_low e is immediate. If c_0<=a_n<1, then epsilon<=e and a_n^2<=1 give a_n(1-a_n)<=(1+D)e, hence 1-a_n<=(1+D)e/c_0. Thus a_n>=1-K_low e with K_low=(1+D)/c_0. Validated node 1.3.2.2 gives b_n<=1+(25+D)e, while a_n<=b_n by definition. Therefore K_boot=max{K_low,25+D} yields 1-K_boot e<=a_n<=b_n<=1+K_boot e, uniformly in n. [BLOCKED: 1.3.2.1, 1.3.2.2]
